sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 4XL+.
Increases damage when using a physical or magic attack Ability by S+.
Target: yourself. Recovers 10 Cost.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by M.
Ability Power scales with the number of Time elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 5XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Time elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
